title: Fine if you don't have badly behaved dogs
text: Fine if you don't have badly behaved dogs. It's not the fault of this item - but I have dogs.  I thought maybe this would help, but the dogs managed to remove it from the chair in about 5 minutes.  Then, I said "bad dogs!" (although I understand their behavior is entirely MY fault)...and put it back on, more firmly.  When I returned 3 minutes later, it was bunched up and the smallest dog was burrowing under it.  So if you don't have dogs, or if you have well-behaved dogs, this will probably be fine for you.  For me, I think I will need to look further for something that can be attached firmly or cover the entire chair - maybe more like those slipcovers they sell at crate & barrel.
